responsibility: Implements the Arm MVE builtin function-shape system that describes intrinsic signatures, overload construction, argument checking, and overload resolution. It parses compact type-description strings into GCC tree types, applies predication-related arguments, builds overloaded and fully typed builtin declarations, resolves calls by inferring vector type suffixes and mode suffixes such as _n or _wb, and enforces immediate and argument-form constraints for specialized intrinsic families. This file therefore owns the frontend-side signature/overload logic for MVE builtins, distinct from the actual RTL expansion of each operation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the function_shape objects and the machinery behind them, including type-string parsing, declaration building, overload resolution, and argument/immediate checks for MVE builtins. Unlike arm-mve-builtins-shapes.h, which only declares the reusable shape descriptors, this .cc file contains the operational rules those descriptors enforce.
